## Rankora UI Design System - Complete Inventory

Based on my exploration of the Rankora codebase, here's the complete design system inventory:

---

### **1. SHADCN/UI Components Available** (46 components)

**Form & Input:** input.tsx, textarea.tsx, label.tsx, checkbox.tsx, radio-group.tsx, select.tsx, toggle.tsx, toggle-group.tsx, switch.tsx, form.tsx, input-otp.tsx

**Layout & Structure:** card.tsx, separator.tsx, sidebar.tsx, sheet.tsx, dialog.tsx, drawer.tsx, scroll-area.tsx, resizable.tsx

**Navigation:** tabs.tsx, breadcrumb.tsx, pagination.tsx, navigation-menu.tsx, menubar.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx

**Display:** badge.tsx, avatar.tsx, progress.tsx, skeleton.tsx, carousel.tsx, table.tsx, calendar.tsx

**Feedback & Interaction:** button.tsx, alert.tsx, alert-dialog.tsx, tooltip.tsx, popover.tsx, hover-card.tsx, context-menu.tsx

**Custom Components:** command.tsx, collapsible.tsx, accordion.tsx, aspect-ratio.tsx, sonner.tsx (toaster), toast.tsx, toaster.tsx, fade-in.tsx, stagger-list.tsx

**File:** `/app/layout.tsx`

**Key Elements:**
```typescript
const inter = Inter({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"],
  display: "swap",
  variable: "--font-inter",
});

// Theme init script (beforeInteractive)
const themeInitScript = `(function() {
  var theme = localStorage.getItem('rankora-theme');
  if (theme === 'dark') {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = 'dark';
  }
})();`;
```
